Record Class Parameter

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.inject.context.Parameter
Record Components:
name - the parameter name (for inspection)
type - the parameter type (its inner type when isProvider)
qualifierType - the marker qualifier annotation type, or null
qualifier - the qualifier annotation instance, or null
annotationMetadata - annotations present on the parameter
isProvider - whether the declared parameter is a Provider of type
public record Parameter(String name, Type type, @Nullable Class<? extends Annotation> qualifierType, @Nullable Annotation qualifier, AnnotationMetadata annotationMetadata, boolean isProvider) extends Record
Describes one constructor or method parameter to inject. A qualifier is either a marker annotation type (qualifierType) or a concrete annotation instance (qualifier); at most one is non-null.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
